chapters.overview: बृहत्पाराशरहोराशास्त्र का अध्याय 1 (सृष्टिक्रमकथाः) — शास्त्रीय श्लोक, पदच्छेद एवं फलित-गणितीय डिकोड।

slokas.deva:
ॐ ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
अथ बृहत्पाराशरहोराशास्त्रम् ॥
गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलसारभक्षणम् ।
उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारणं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपंकजम् ॥
सृष्टिक्रमकथनाध्यायः
slokas.translit:
oṃ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
atha bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstram ||
gajānanaṃ bhūtagaṇādisevitaṃ kapitthajambūphalasārabhakṣaṇam |
umāsutaṃ śokavināśakāraṇaṃ namāmi vighneśvarapādapaṃkajam ||
sṛṣṭikramakathanādhyāyaḥ
slokas.translation: The opening is a maṅgala to Gaṇeśa—elephant-faced, served by the hosts of beings, relish of wood-apple and rose-apple essence, son of Umā, remover of sorrow—bowing to the lotus feet of Vighneśvara. The section is then titled the chapter that narrates the order of creation.
slokas.source: editions/parashara-rahasya-full-edition.html#v1-1 — Devanāgarī, IAST, padaccheda-anvaya and English rendering as printed in the edition (BPHS 1.1)

chapters.overview: बृहत्पाराशरहोराशास्त्र का अध्याय 2 (अथावतारकथाः) — शास्त्रीय श्लोक, पदच्छेद एवं फलित-गणितीय डिकोड।

slokas.deva:
रामकृष्णादयो ये ह्यवतारा रमापतेः।
तेऽपि जीवांशसंयुक्ताः किंवा ब्रूहि मुनिश्वर
slokas.translit:
rāmakṛṣṇādayo ye hyavatārā ramāpateḥ|
te'pi jīvāṃśasaṃyuktāḥ kiṃvā brūhi muniśvara

anvaya.en: राम, कृष्ण आदि (विष्णु के प्रसिद्ध अवतार)
जीव-अंश से युक्त (परमात्मा-अंश के सापेक्ष जीव-भाग)

slokas.translation: Maitreya asks the sage: are the descents of the Lord of Ramā—Rāma, Kṛṣṇa and the rest—also joined with a jīva-portion, or how else should they be understood? The verse opens the avatāra inquiry that the next answers resolve.
